text: Our cities woke to explosions today. Some people are in shelters. Others are already helping their neighbours. The government is working. We are staying here.
Bondarenko reporting. We are getting people into shelters. The troops are asking for orders.
Cover the evacuation. Keep enemy aircraft from making uncontested runs over our cities. Our units are already holding the line.
Understood. That is a lot of sky for a small brigade.
There is an idea. No details over the radio yet. Meet me in Pechersk, by the old hangar.
